reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Normal-prior NB model, high-replicate internal reference/downsampling, simulations and a separate independent biological cohort.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

checks.quote: Report the posterior mean or mode
checks.reason: The estimator itself is not selected between mean/mode; normalization, prior-scale fitting and solver/calibration-to-acceptance remain unspecified.

checks.quote: calibration remains acceptable
checks.reason: Calibration is required but no coverage/error acceptance tolerance or concrete pilot-to-tolerance and failure-response procedure is defined.

checks.quote: Signed error against high-replicate reference.
checks.reason: Reference-effect uncertainty and selection of strong reference genes are acknowledged qualitatively but not propagated in loss/coverage estimates. These reference errors are distinct from the shared-observation issue in P16.

checks.quote: Monte Carlo uncertainty is sufficiently small
checks.reason: Independent biological units are explicit, but sufficiently-small Monte Carlo uncertainty has no numerical precision target and the 1,000-run starting point is not a stopping justification. Biological validation sample size has no power/precision procedure.
Eligibility intent is present but failed-fit/missing-measurement handling, all-eligible denominators and stopping/maximal acquisition rules remain unspecified.
No executable primary method-difference uncertainty procedure and relevant multiplicity/error-control rule is fixed; listing metrics or interval outputs is insufficient.
Sensitivity scenarios are named, but bounded settings or a concrete derivation-and-lock procedure for the essential prior/filter/model choices are absent.
Possible failure modes are named without a diagnostic result linked to an ordered technical repair and retest.
No operational iteration policy identifies what stays frozen, what may change and the fresh independent confirmation required after a change.

checks.quote: Fit the same model to all eligible high-replicate samples
checks.reason: The full-data reference reuses observations in each small subset; acknowledging it is not fully independent does not correct this dependence. Use disjoint references or quantify dependence before comparing errors. Separate new-cohort validation is credited under P14.
Figure concepts do not supply numeric source tables plus a clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit.
